jobs_results.job_title: Market Analyst, Commercial Markets & Data Analytics
jobs_results.description:
Job Type

Full-time

Description

Location: Houston, TX (Galleria)

Reports to: Senior Managing Director, Commercial Markets & Data Analytics

Who We Are

Priority Power is the energy partner delivering the systems, expertise, and execution, required to power enterprise growth. Through our integrated multi-service offering spanning strategy, supply, infrastructure, and operations, we develop and operate mission critical energy solutions for organizations navigating today's complex energy landscape. From greenfield to gigawatt to grid, we make power possible at the scale and speed of ambitious growth demands - meeting the needs of an energy driven future.

Our Mission

Priority Power delivers the strategy, infrastructure, and execution that powers enterprise growth - with the speed, transparency, and accountability our clients depend on.

Our Vision

To be the most trusted and capable integrated energy partner in the United States -delivering strategy, infrastructure, and execution at the speed ambitious growth demands.

Position Summary

The Market Analyst supports power and natural gas forward curve marking, data analytics, and customer-facing market communication, with a focus on ERCOT and PJM. This role is flexible in level, from junior analyst to a more experienced hire, depending on the candidate's background. Prior experience with ERCOT, PJM, or other ISOs is a strong plus.

The analyst will maintain forward price curves, help identify pricing trends across power markets, and support customer-facing market presentations, recaps, and outlooks.

Position Responsibilities



Mark and maintain forward price curves for ERCOT and PJM power products.Maintain and analyze large Excel workbooks, performing ad hoc analysis as needed Help build and deliver customer-facing market update decks, presenting market moves and analysis directly to customers and internal sales teamsWrite and publish quarterly market recaps and outlooks covering ERCOT and PJM fundamentalsPartner with Commercial Markets leadership and internal teams to align market commentary and analysis with broader company messagingIdentify opportunities to improve or automate existing analytics and reporting processes

Requirements

Bachelor's degree in quantitative field (Finance, Economics, Statistics, or related), or equivalent experience.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience working with Databricks, PostgreSQL, or Amazon Athena/S3Comfort writing SQL queries and managing data pulls across multiple database environmentsExperience building visualizations and dashboards in TableauFamiliarity applying statistical or analytical methods to identify pricing trends

Why Choose Priority Power?

Empowered to Make an Impact in a Values-Driven Energy Future

At Priority Power, we’re more than just an energy company—we’re a purpose-driven team dedicated to transforming the future of energy through meaningful work, empowered people, and enduring partnerships. We invite mission-minded professionals to grow with us in a culture defined by trust, collaboration, and real outcomes.

Values-Driven Culture

We lead with integrity, customer focus, and accountability—prioritizing ethics and purpose in every decision we make. Our culture is rooted in doing what’s right for our clients, our communities, and each other.

Empowered Opportunities

Here, initiative is celebrated. You’ll have the autonomy to lead, innovate, and contribute in ways that grow your career and advance our mission. We empower our employees to take ownership of their impact.

Accountability & Outcomes Orientation

Our results matter. We are a high-performance culture that rewards accountability, champions progress and celebrates milestones that move the needle for our clients and the energy industry.

Collaborative Colleagues

You’ll work alongside passionate experts who are generous with knowledge and united by a shared vision. Cross-functional teamwork and open communication are at the core of how we solve big energy challenges together.

Make a Real Difference

At Priority Power, your work directly contributes to building a more resilient, efficient, and sustainable energy future. Whether optimizing large-scale power strategies or innovating in renewables, you’ll be part of something bigger than yourself.

Flexible Work Environment

We respect your life outside of work. Our flexible work policies allow you to thrive personally and professionally ensuring balance, trust, and well-being for every team member.

Equal Opportunity Employer

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity in our workforce. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or disability.

Live Nation Entertainment is hiring a Senior Data Analyst, Marketing with 3 - 5 years of experience. Based in United States - Beverly Hills, CA  and with Hybrid ways of working. 
  
  Job description and responsibilities: 

WHO ARE YOU?


Passionate and motivated. Driven, with an entrepreneurial spirit. Resourceful, innovative, forward thinking and committed. At Live Nation Entertainment, our people embrace these qualities, so if this sounds like you then please read on!


THE TEAM


We are excited about music, live entertainment, marketing, data, and technology. We are driven by a passion to understand the root causes of complicated problems and partner with stakeholders to discover and implement solutions. Most of us had no previous experience working in music -- just a shared excitement about the space, a willingness to go to concerts / venues / festivals when needed as part of the job, and a desire to go to concerts / venues / festivals in our free time, too.


The Marketing Insights and Data Analytics Services team within the Marketing & Data Strategy organization works on projects across all divisions, to develop insights around Fans and Marketing programs. These insights are used to inspire new marketing programs and improve existing marketing efforts across Concerts, Ticketmaster, and Sponsorship business units. We are also responsible for quantifying the value of our marketing efforts through our test and learn program, incrementality testing and attribution thought leadership.


THE ROLE


The Senior Marketing Data Analyst will play a strategic role in leveraging advanced data science techniques, statistical modeling, and analytics to drive marketing effectiveness and business growth. You will lead the development and implementation of data-driven strategies, provide guidance to junior analysts, and collaborate with cross-functional teams to optimize marketing campaigns and improve customer targeting. Your expertise in data science, marketing analytics, and leadership will be instrumental in shaping the organization's marketing strategies and driving innovation.


The ideal candidate is curious, detail-oriented, and collaborative. They are focused on driving insights - pulling data, building dashboards, and creating recommendations. This person will report to the VP of Analytics.


What This Role Will Do



Ensure data accuracy, completeness, and consistency through data quality checks and validation processes.
Apply advanced statistical and machine learning techniques to analyze marketing data and uncover meaningful insights.
Lead the development of predictive models to identify customer behavior patterns, predict customer lifetime value, and segment customers for targeted marketing campaigns.
Utilize data clustering, regression analysis, decision trees, and other modelling techniques to solve marketing problems and optimize marketing strategies.
Analyze test results using statistical methods to determine statistically significant findings and guide decision-making processes.
Collaborate with marketing teams to iterate and refine marketing strategies based on test outcomes.
Develop interactive dashboards and visualizations to communicate complex marketing data insights to stakeholders.
Create regular reports and presentations that highlight key findings, trends, and performance metrics.
Present data-driven recommendations and insights to marketing teams, management, and other relevant stakeholders.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including marketing, product management, sales, and IT, to align data-driven strategies with business objectives.

 
  
  Requirements and qualifications: WHAT THIS PERSON WILL BRING:


Required Technical Skills/Competencies



Bachelor’s degree from an accredited university or college in Computer Science, Marketing Science, Marketing Analytics or similar quantitative field
4+ years of experience with any combination of advanced and predictive analytics, marketing analytics, and analytic techniques for marketing, customer, and business applications
2+ years crafting and developing business intelligence dashboards using any BI tools
Extensive experience with SQL and Python / R
Technical understanding of probability & statistics, machine learning and optimization algorithms.
Experience creating dashboards, authoring reporting and troubleshooting BI reporting and dashboard platforms such as DOMO, Tableau or similar tool
Experience incorporating complex data sets from different data sources, such as our database, redshift clusters and other API’s into BI reporting and dashboard platforms
Expertise in MS Excel – lookups, pivot tables, dynamic charts and tables required
Experience in schema design and dimensional data modeling and building data pipelines
Ability to translate complicated analyses into plain language, both in speaking and writing
Technical understanding of probability & statistics, machine learning and optimization algorithms.
Ensure quality of data and accuracy of downstream reporting through precise attention to detail
Collaborate with programmers, engineers and business analysts to test, clean, and standardized data to meet the business requirements
Strong verbal/written communication and data presentation skills, including an ability to effectively communicate with both business and technical teams

DESIRED TECHNICAL SKILLS/COMPETENCIES:



Prior experience with Analytical Modelling Platform or Media/Agency Industry experience
Familiarity with a broad set of topics and subject areas within marketing analytics (e.g. campaign attribution/effectiveness, web tracking, customer lifecycle marketing)
Experience in Marketing Mix Modelling
Experience analyzing clickstream and conversion data (Google Analytics, Adobe Analytics, AppsFlyer)
Experience analyzing Digital Marketing performance (search, email, social, programmatic display, etc.)
Experience working in Entertainment industry

General Purpose


The Marketing Reporting Analyst is responsible for gathering, organizing, and interpreting marketing data from multiple channels (paid search, social, email, display, etc.) to evaluate campaign effectiveness, forecast trends, and support budget allocation decisions. The position handles all customer surveys and insights for the organization. This position could be based out of any of Alpine Bank’s locations, pending available space.


Essential Duties/Responsibilities


Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.



Responsible for developing executive reporting and deeper level reporting for the company and the marketing department.
Monitors and forecasts marketing performance in all PESO stages, allowing lifecycle stage reporting to educate and inform on performance level of marketing efforts.
Identifies trends and correlated data early in a marketing campaign process to ensure strategic goals are met.
Builds and maintains dashboards in Power BI, Looker Studio, or other contemporary reporting systems.
Supports budget allocation decisions by modeling expected ROI within the funnel reporting process.
Designs, develops, implements, analyzes, and reports the annual customer loyalty survey, distributing results to Management.
Designs, develops, implements, analyzes, and reports the monthly customer onboarding survey, distributing results to Management.
Develops market position reports for the company and its operating units as requested. 
Performs special studies and develops data and information, assessment and recommendations as requested. 
Collaborates with the Marketing team in developing campaigns and promotions.
Regular and reliable on-site attendance is required as an essential function of this position.
Performs other duties as assigned. 

Employees are held accountable for all duties of this job. 


Job Qualifications


Knowledge, Skills, and Ability:



Deep understanding of event causing relative data and highly correlated leading indicators to determine success early in a marketing campaign process.
Ability to communicate and collaborate with team members to ensure superior results and team success.
Ability to implement new ideas or potential solutions without prompting.
Skill in identifying problems and using logic, judgment, and data to solve problems most desirable for the company.
Understanding how to identify problems and willingness to make recommendations to address them. 
Effectively managing one’s time and resources to ensure that work is completed efficiently.
Good critical thinking and analytical skills.

Education or Formal Training:



A bachelor’s degree in Marketing Research, Data Analytics or MIS preferred. 
Possession of, or ability to obtain a valid Colorado Driver’s License required.

Experience:



A minimum of two years of experience providing data analysis to an organization, work within a banking environment is preferred. 
An equivalent combination of education and experience may be substituted. 

Working Conditions


Working Environment:


This job operates in a professional office environment. After successful training in the role, the role allows for a hybrid schedule to include remote work and in office. In-office attendance requires a minimum of three (3) days per week. This arrangement can be modified at any time, at management discretion. This role routinely uses standard office equipment such as computers, phones, and multifunction printers. Occasional travel may be required.


Physical Activities:


These are representative of those which must be met to successfully perform the essential functions of this job.


While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk and hear. This is largely a sedentary role. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, and ability to adjust focus. Employee may have to lift up to 25 pounds.  


Note: This job description is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or qualifications associated with the job. 


Starting Range of Pay is from $67,184 - $78,624, annually, depending on experience.

Position Overview

As the Director of Worldwide Marketing Data Strategy & Analytics, you will lead the strategy, measurement frameworks, data foundations, and analytical capabilities that enable Autodesk to understand and optimize Enterprise marketing’s impact on customer and business outcomes. You will lead a global team of data strategists and analysts responsible for transforming complex data into actionable insights, predictive intelligence, and decision-support capabilities across the enterprise marketing funnel and broader go-to-market ecosystem.

This role reports to the Senior Director of Worldwide Marketing Business Insights & Analytics and plays a critical role in advancing Autodesk’s journey toward audience-centric customer experiences and data-driven commercial decision-making. You will partner closely with Marketing and Go-to-Market leadership and across analytics and technology domains, including Sales, Data Science, Data Engineering, and Marketing Technology.

Responsibilities

Lead Marketing Data & Analytics Strategy: Own the end-to-end strategy, execution, and adoption of marketing analytics, measurement frameworks, and intelligence capabilities, partnering with Marketing leadership to translate business priorities into scalable analytical solutions for Enterprise MarketingLead a Global Analytics Team: Recruit, develop, and lead a high-performing global team of data strategists and analysts, providing strategic direction, hands-on guidance, and opportunities for talent growthDrive Business Performance Intelligence: Monitor and analyze business performance to identify emerging trends, risks, opportunities, and actionable levers for Marketing, including early indicators of pipeline performance and opportunities to improve business outcomesDefine Marketing Measurement & Attribution Strategy: Partner with Sales and Marketing leaders to establish measurement principles, KPIs, conversion definitions, attribution methodologies and windows, incrementality approaches, and other frameworks for evaluating marketing effectiveness and connecting marketing investment to customer and commercial outcomesDrive Marketing Effectiveness & Investment Optimization: Integrate attribution, incrementality, experimentation, marketing mix modeling, and predictive analytics to identify performance drivers and inform resource allocation across audiences, channels, campaigns, and programsEstablish Analytics-Ready Data Foundations: Define the business and analytical requirements for foundational marketing data structures, including data models, taxonomies, event structures, identity resolution, campaign hierarchies, and governance required to reliably connect marketing activity with customer and business outcomesAdvance AI-Powered Analytics & Decisioning: Partner across Data Engineering, Data Science, Enterprise AI/ML, Marketing Technology, and Marketing to build scalable, governed capabilities that enable AI agents to generate insights, identify opportunities, recommend and optimize decisions, and orchestrate marketing actions with appropriate human oversightDrive Adoption & Executive Decision Support: Translate complex analytical findings into clear business implications and recommendations, enabling leaders to understand what happened, why it happened, what is likely to happen next, and what actions should be taken

Minimum Qualifications

To be successful in this role, you have:

10+ years of professional experience with significant domain expertise in B2B marketing, sales, go-to-market, or customer analytics5+ years of people leadership experience managing and developing technical and analytical talent, preferably across global or distributed teamsDemonstrated experience developing and operationalizing marketing measurement strategies, including attribution, incrementality, experimentation, marketing mix modeling, funnel measurement, and marketing effectivenessStrong understanding of modern marketing and customer data foundations, including data models, customer and contact identity, campaign and event taxonomies, cloud data platforms, and business intelligence environmentsExperience applying predictive analytics, data science, and AI/ML-enabled capabilities to business and marketing problems, with an understanding of the data, governance, and measurement foundations required to support AI-powered analytics and decisioningDemonstrated ability to translate ambiguous business questions into analytical frameworks, measurement approaches, data requirements, and actionable recommendationsProven ability to communicate with and influence senior non-technical stakeholders while establishing strong partnerships with Data Engineering, Data Science, AI/ML, Marketing Technology, and other technical teamsDemonstrated experience partnering across Marketing, Sales, Sales Operations, Customer Success, and other Go-to-Market functions to drive measurable business outcomesStrong executive communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to translate complex analytical findings into clear strategic implications, recommendations, and decisionsAbility to lead multiple strategic priorities in a fast-paced, highly cross-functional environment while maintaining high standards for analytical rigor, quality, and business impactBA/BS in Marketing, Business, Economics, Statistics, Data Science, or another quantitative or relevant field; advanced degree preferred but not required

26WD100769 Directeur de la stratégie et de l’analyse des données marketing mondiales

Aperçu du Poste

En tant que directeur de la stratégie et de l’analyse des données marketing mondiales, vous dirigerez la stratégie, les cadres de mesure, les bases de données et les capacités analytiques qui permettent à Autodesk de comprendre et d’optimiser l’impact du marketing d’entreprise sur les résultats clients et commerciaux. Vous dirigerez une équipe mondiale de stratèges et d’analystes de données chargés de transformer des données complexes en informations exploitables, en intelligence prédictive et en capacités d’aide à la décision à travers l’entonnoir de marketing d’entreprise et l’écosystème de mise en marché au sens large.

Ce poste relève du directeur principal des analyses et des perspectives d’affaires du marketing mondial et joue un rôle essentiel dans la progression d’Autodesk vers des expériences client centrées sur l’auditoire et une prise de décision commerciale fondée sur les données. Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les dirigeants du marketing et de la mise en marché, ainsi qu’avec les équipes des domaines de l’analyse et de la technologie, notamment les ventes, la science des données, l’ingénierie des données et la technologie marketing.

Responsabilités

Diriger la stratégie en matière de données et d’analyse marketing : Assumer la responsabilité de la stratégie de bout en bout, de la mise en œuvre et de l’adoption des analyses marketing, des cadres de mesure et des capacités d’intelligence, en collaboration avec la direction du marketing afin de traduire les priorités d’affaires en solutions analytiques évolutives pour le marketing d’entrepriseDiriger une équipe mondiale d’analyse : Recruter, former et diriger une équipe mondiale hautement performante composée de stratèges et d’analystes de données, en fournissant une orientation stratégique, des conseils pratiques et des occasions de développement des talentsFavoriser l’intelligence de la performance d’affaires : Surveiller et analyser la performance d’affaires afin d’identifier les tendances émergentes, les risques, les occasions et les leviers exploitables pour le marketing, y compris les indicateurs précoces de la performance du pipeline et les occasions d’améliorer les résultats d’affairesDéfinir la stratégie de mesure et d’attribution marketing : Travailler en partenariat avec les dirigeants des ventes et du marketing pour établir des principes de mesure, des indicateurs de performance clés (IPK), des définitions de conversion, des méthodologies et des fenêtres d’attribution, des approches d’incrémentalité, ainsi que d’autres cadres permettant d’évaluer l’efficacité du marketing et de relier les investissements marketing aux résultats commerciaux et auprès des clientsOptimiser l’efficacité du marketing et les investissements : Intégrer l’attribution, l’incrémentalité, l’expérimentation, la modélisation du mix marketing et l’analyse prédictive afin d’identifier les facteurs de performance et d’orienter l’allocation des ressources entre les audiences, les canaux, les campagnes et les programmesÉtablir des fondations de données prêtes pour l’analyse : Définir les exigences opérationnelles et analytiques relatives aux structures de données marketing fondamentales, y compris les modèles de données, les taxonomies, les structures d’événements, la résolution d’identité, les hiérarchies de campagnes et la gouvernance nécessaire pour relier de manière fiable les activités marketing aux résultats clients et d’affairesFaire progresser l’analyse et la prise de décision alimentées par l’IA : Collaborer avec les équipes d’ingénierie des données, de science des données, d’IA/ML d’entreprise, de technologie marketing et de marketing afin de mettre en place des capacités évolutives et régies permettant aux agents d’IA de générer des informations, d’identifier des occasions, de recommander et d’optimiser les décisions, ainsi que d’orchestrer les actions marketing sous une supervision humaine appropriéeFavoriser l’adoption et soutenir la prise de décision de la haute direction : Traduire des résultats analytiques complexes en implications commerciales claires et en recommandations, permettant ainsi aux dirigeants de comprendre ce qui s’est passé, pourquoi cela s’est produit, ce qui est susceptible de se produire ensuite et quelles mesures devraient être prises

Qualifications Minimales

Pour réussir dans ce poste, vous devez posséder :

Plus de 10 ans d’expérience professionnelle avec une expertise approfondie dans les domaines du marketing B2B, des ventes, de la mise en marché ou de l’analyse de la clientèlePlus de 5 ans d’expérience en leadership, notamment dans la gestion et le développement de talents techniques et analytiques, de préférence au sein d’équipes internationales ou disperséesUne expérience avérée dans l’élaboration et la mise en œuvre de stratégies de mesure marketing, notamment l’attribution, l’incrémentalité, l’expérimentation, la modélisation du mix marketing, la mesure de l’entonnoir de conversion et l’efficacité marketingUne solide compréhension des fondements du marketing moderne et des données clients, y compris les modèles de données, l’identité des clients et des contacts, les taxonomies de campagnes et d’événements, les plateformes de données en nuage et les environnements d’intelligence d’affairesUne expérience dans l’application de l’analyse prédictive, de la science des données et des capacités basées sur l’IA et l’apprentissage automatique (IA/ML) à des problèmes d’affaires et de marketing, avec une compréhension des fondements en matière de données, de gouvernance et de mesure nécessaires pour soutenir l’analyse et la prise de décision alimentées par l’IACapacité avérée à traduire des questions d’affaires ambiguës en cadres analytiques, en approches de mesure, en exigences en matière de données et en recommandations concrètesCapacité avérée à communiquer avec des intervenants de haut niveau non spécialisés dans le domaine technique et à les influencer, tout en établissant des partenariats solides avec les équipes d’ingénierie des données, de science des données, d’IA/ML, de technologie marketing et d’autres équipes techniquesExpérience avérée de la collaboration avec les équipes de marketing, des ventes, des opérations commerciales, de la réussite client et d’autres fonctions liées à la mise en marché afin de générer des résultats d’affaires mesurablesSolides compétences en communication avec la haute direction et en narration, avec la capacité de traduire des résultats analytiques complexes en implications stratégiques, en recommandations et en décisions clairesCapacité à mener de front plusieurs priorités stratégiques dans un environnement dynamique et hautement interfonctionnel, tout en maintenant des normes élevées en matière de rigueur analytique, de qualité et d’impact commercialBaccalauréat en marketing, en administration des affaires, en économie, en statistiques, en science des données ou dans un autre domaine quantitatif ou pertinent; un diplôme d’études supérieures est préférable, mais n’est pas obligatoire
